en.headline: 1 own commit plus 13 automated; commented on openchamber #4939
en.summary: In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, **1 own commit** added a new `opencode-provider` knowledge category covering catalog three-layer sources, credential ownership, endpoints, and OpenChamber governance. The `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` repo had 13 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. I commented on 1 issue: openchamber/openchamber #4939 about text selection inside `openchamber_render` pages not triggering the comment menu. I also started discussion #5114 proposing to split the fix into a frame→host selection bridge first. I received 2 replies: `btriapitsyn` confirmed #4601 was fixed in `7d037b07d`, and `yulia-ivashko` reported #4899 could not be reproduced. Three issues were closed by `btriapitsyn`: #4896, #4920, and #4601. No pull requests, code reviews, or releases occurred.

zh.headline: 1 次本人提交，另有 13 次自动提交；评论了 openchamber #4939
zh.summary: 在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中有 **1 次本人提交**，新增了 `opencode-provider` 知识类别，涵盖 catalog 三层来源、凭据归属、端点及 OpenChamber 管辖。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 仓库另有 13 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。我评论了 1 个 issue：openchamber/openchamber #4939，关于 `openchamber_render` 页面内选中文本无法触发评论菜单的问题。我还发起了讨论 #5114，建议将修复拆分为先做 frame→host 选区桥接。收到 2 条回复：`btriapitsyn` 确认 #4601 已在 `7d037b07d` 中修复，`yulia-ivashko` 表示 #4899 无法复现。当天 `btriapitsyn` 关闭了 3 个 issue：#4896、#4920 和 #4601。无 PR、代码审查或新版本发布。
